messages:
rachael_csm: Quick heads-up — we need to finalize the quarterly impact deck for Castaway by Friday. Can owners + open risks posted by EOD Wed? :spiral_calendar_pad:

maria_cs: I can own the onboarding status slide. Will pull activation funnel + 30/60/90 cohorts.

josh_se: I'll take demo reliability + any failed flows. Can someone paste the latest incident summary?

alex_eng: copying logs now. small note: model fallback latencies improved after the hotfix; will include 95p/99p numbers.

emily_pm: I'll add adoption highlights and the two customer asks we promised to prioritize. Need a short quote from the CSM side for the exec narrative.

sam_ops: Can ops confirm SLA adherence and capacity headroom? We should flag renewal risk if capacity lines up with upcoming churn.

maria_cs: @sam_ops expect a short blurb by tomorrow. I'll also surface recent support ticket themes.

josh_se: Incident summary:
```
- 2024-11-09: transient GPU OOM on ded-dev pool, fallback to smaller model, p99 latency spike ~1.8s, mitigated by autoscale.
- 2024-11-12: storage backend retry storm, degraded embeddings job for ~10m, no data loss.
```
I'll attach the full runbook link in the doc.

alex_eng: Note for slides: include the mitigation we rolled (auto model downgrade + cache priming). Helps the execs see we have a clear fallback.

emily_pm: Exec rehearsal tentatively Tues 10:30 PT. Who can make time for a 20m run?

rachael_csm: @alex_eng @josh_se can you both join? engineering voice needed for demo fallback + perf Qs.

alex_eng: yes, I'll be there.

josh_se: can do.

sam_ops: I'll join for the SLA and capacity bit.

maria_cs: I'll run the customer narrative and the risk slide. Need a one-liner renewal ask — recommend "commit to Dedicated pilot to stabilize throughput" — thoughts?

emily_pm: sounds right. Maybe soften to "evaluate Dedicated pilot to improve predictability" for exec audience.

maria_cs: good call, updated.

rachael_csm: Action list (brief):
- maria_cs: onboarding slide + ticket themes (EOD Wed)
- josh_se: incident summary + demo notes (tomorrow)
- alex_eng: perf numbers + mitigation description (tomorrow)
- emily_pm: adoption metrics + exec narrative (Thu morning)
- sam_ops: SLA capacity blurb + renewal-risk flag (tomorrow)

rachael_csm: I'll stitch into the deck and share a Google Slides link by Thu afternoon. Please add comments directly. :thumbsup:

notifier_bot: Reminder scheduled: Exec rehearsal Tue 10:30 PT — calendar invite will be sent 24h prior.

maria_cs: Also: can we include one customer quote about ROI? @emily_pm / @rachael_csm — I can draft a couple options.

emily_pm: @maria_cs please draft. I'll edit for tone.

rachael_csm: Perfect. If anyone spots a blocker (data access, permissions, or slide gaps) call it out here. Otherwise we'll treat this as our single source of truth for tasks.

josh_se: No blockers from eng. Attaching the perf CSV to the thread doc shortly.

alex_eng: Linking a short snippet for the fallback flow in case we need a flow-diagram: https://intra.redwood/diagrams/fallback-flow

maria_cs: thanks all — will post my slide notes by EOD Wed.

emily_pm: thanks team. We'll aim to keep the deck to 8 slides + appendix.

sam_ops: Added capacity numbers to the shared sheet.

rachael_csm: Great work — will ping again when the deck draft is up. :raised_hands:
